modos.descricao: Na Umbra: +1 Rage, +1 Gnosis, +1 Health (Gn4, Philodox)

params.descricao: Power of the Ways: +1 a Rage, Gnosis e Health enquanto estiver na Umbra. Descarta ao retornar ao mundo fisico.

_metadata.texto_original: When in the Umbra the Philodox increases her Rage, Gnosis, and Health by 1. Discard this Gift when she returns to the physical world. A character cannot use more than one Power of the Ways at a time.
